verdict.rationale: Granola Chat accepts natural-language requests: users can query all meetings, a single meeting, or a folder, and can ask Chat to draft and send follow-up emails, send Slack messages and create Google Calendar events, with a review step before anything is sent. Recipes save these prompts for reuse. The documented scope is querying notes and post-meeting workflows, not operating the product as a whole, so coverage of 'operate the product' is only partial. Missing for 10: natural-language control of core product functions (organizing folders, sharing, settings, templates, starting or stopping transcription), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Chat's command execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
you can save your favorite prompts as recipes and run them with a single click.
